reasoning_trace.detail: Identified product 'LED Street Lamps', rating '15W', domain 'Smart City / Highway Lighting'.

plain_language_explanation.text: For 15W LED street lamps, mandatory safety compliance is governed by **IS 16102 (Part 1):2012** under the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS). Vendors must provide their 8-digit BIS CRS 'R-Number'. Ensure the tender also mandates Part 2 performance criteria and IS 15885 driver surge protection.

compliance_checklist.item: Mandate BIS CRS Registration Number (R-Number) on luminaire packaging
compliance_checklist.action_required: Verify vendor registration status on BIS CRS portal before bid opening.
Demand accredited laboratory photometric test report.
Specify external surge protection device (SPD) in technical tender clause.

staleness_risk.message: Standard is active and CRS enforcement is in full effect.
